text:
Maria Gomez: Heads-up: v2 of /history goes live tomorrow. v2 uses a compact delta encoding and slightly different item shape (renamed fields + embedded refs). We need a compatibility shim plan before flipping default traffic.

Josh Li: Gateway-level shim seems easiest - check header and expand on-the-fly. Concern: CPU cost per-request when rehydrating.

Suda Patel: Two plausible approaches:
- Stateless on-the-fly rehydrate in gateway (no extra datastore, but CPU/latency hit).
- Stateful backfill/cache: a background job rewrites/expands v2 payload into a tenant cache so gateway serves v1 shape fast (adds storage + eviction).

Maria Gomez: Tradeoffs: stateless = lower infra complexity, harder P95/P99; stateful = higher infra complexity + storage, better latency for hot tenants. Also consider cold-start for tenants after backfill.

Tanvi Rao: Proposal: phased rollout with an opt-in header for tenants to use shim. Emit telemetry: shim_used, rehydrate_time_ms, shim_fallback=true/false, tenant_id. Start with 5 canary tenants.

Oleg Petrov: Streaming nuance — v2 streams chunked diffs. Rehydration needs to stitch diffs back into the original framing for older clients. Might require a streaming sidecar that buffers+reframes.

Deploy Bot: Canary deploy to gateways succeeded for tenants t-42, t-77, t-501. Initial metrics: p95 latency +30ms, gateway CPU +12% on canary nodes. No errors yet. :eyes:

Josh Li: If CPU/regression is unacceptable, fallback plan should route requests to the v1-serving pool (route policy + feature flag). Need an emergency kill-switch.

Suda Patel: Implementation sketch (gateway middleware):
```
if request.headers["X-Redwood-History-Shim"] == "v1" then
  // accept v2 payload from backend
  body = read_stream(response)
  expanded = rehydrate_compact_history(body) // cpu work here
  write_response(expanded)
else
  passthrough()
end
```
We should make rehydrate_compact_history pluggable so we can swap to a sidecar-based path later.

Maria Gomez: Action items:
- Suda: build gateway middleware + toggle flag (owner)
- Tanvi: add telemetry metrics + alert when shim_rate > 10% or rehydrate_time_ms p95 > 200ms
- Oleg: prototype streaming sidecar for chunked diffs (owner)
- Josh: add route fallback and emergency kill-switch to runbook
Timeline: start canary tomorrow, evaluate after 48h, aim for tenant opt-in period of 2 weeks before defaulting.

Tanvi Rao: :thumbsup: I'll add dashboards and an on-call alert (pager if shim_rate spikes).

Oleg Petrov: I'll draft a PR for the sidecar and a minimal e2e test for streaming reframe.

Maria Gomez: Thanks team — keep the thread updated with canary metrics. If anyone hits a blocker, @here and we'll triage. :shipit:
